user_prompt: We need to pull together a comprehensive view of our production risks and costs right now - I want to see both our material expenses broken down by supplier along with any compliance gaps, and at the same time analyze our recent safety incidents and trends across all our manufacturing sites. Can you get me both of those datasets so we can address cost optimization and safety improvements in our next operations review?

steps.step_name: Pull material expenses broken down by supplier to support cost optimization analysis

args.reason: Exposes Purchase Order and Vendor entities with pricing details, enabling extraction of material costs broken down by supplier for cost optimization analysis.

method_trace.picked_reason: Exposes Purchase Order and Vendor entities with pricing details, enabling extraction of material costs broken down by supplier for cost optimization analysis.

steps.step_name: Identify and report on compliance gaps across our production operations

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (11 total):
- workday.hcm: HCM with compensation agents but NO API resources
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - INCLUDES:
  * apiResource:EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 - Extract payroll/compensation records
  * agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1 - Compensation policy automation
  * agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 - Workforce planning
- sap.s4: ERP - agents (procurement, order automation, engineering change), MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (goods receipt inbound only)
- sap.crm: CRM with opportunity qualification AGENTS ONLY - NO API resources for customer account/purchase data
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - AGENTS ONLY - SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator (BOM validation), IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer
- sap.ariba: Procurement - APIs (PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI, SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI, ProcurementWorkforceCompensationAPI), agent validating hazardous materials
- corp.itsm: IT service management
- emarsys.cx: Customer experience/marketing engagement AGENTS ONLY - NO API resources
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionQualityMonitor, ProductionChangeOrchestrator, SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator (vendor/procurement compliance), BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator AGENTS ONLY - NO data APIs for production scheduling
- siemens.plm: PLM - BOMComplianceValidator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention, SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator AGENTS ONLY
- sap.odm: Entity type repository (not API provider)

GOODS RECEIPT vs INVOICING:
- MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (sap.s4) handles goods receipt/shipment arrival BEFORE invoice
- Goods receipt is separate warehouse/inventory process
- Invoicing is separate downstream process

PRODUCTION COMPLIANCE GAPS IDENTIFICATION:
- my.mes:agent:SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator:v1 - BEST MATCH
  * Monitors supplier quality metrics and vendor compliance status
  * Processes incoming material inspections, escalates non-conformance issues
  * Orchestrates quality certifications and supplier audit schedules
  * Works in production context with POs, Vendors, Contracts
  * Handles gap identification and reporting/escalation workflows

args.reason: This agent monitors supplier quality metrics and vendor compliance status in manufacturing operations, automatically detects non-conformance issues, and orchestrates quality certifications and audit schedules to identify and report compliance gaps.

method_trace.picked_reason: This agent monitors supplier quality metrics and vendor compliance status in manufacturing operations, automatically detects non-conformance issues, and orchestrates quality certifications and audit schedules to identify and report compliance gaps.
